description: Use for 'which accounts have an open buying signal?'. Returns open leads (id eop_..., dated proof with links, what it usually means for what you sell, rough time frame); filter closing_soon returns the ones that usually wind down within 30 days. Use the returned id with get_best_contact, get_project_updates and mark_opportunity. Saved records only.
name: list_opportunities

held.description: Leads held back by the quality gate (no dated, linked proof).

opportunities.description: Open leads, highest priority first, each with its proof.

change_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD the source dates the change.

checked_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD Intakra last checked the source.

paste_line.description: One sentence a rep can paste that cites the evidence with its date, or null when the stored fields do not support one.

quote.description: The source's own words (dashes folded, clipped), or null when none is stored.

quote_note.description: When quote_status is not_stored, the plain sentence that says so. Null when a quote is stored.

quote_status.description: stored: quote holds the source's words. not_stored: no quote is stored for this lead.

quote_text.description: The quote delimited as a quote ("The source says: ..."), or null when none is stored.

source_url.description: The link the quote, or with no quote the lead's newest source, is on.

usually_means.description: What this usually means for what the workspace sells. An interpretation, not confirmed intent.

what_we_found.description: The dated proof, newest first, each with a link to its source when there is one.

date.description: When the event happened, else when Intakra first saw it.

title: List leads
